seo.title: 2025 Life Sciences Thought Leadership Series
seo.description: Register now for Exeevo’s Executive 2025 Virtual Thought Leadership Series— unrecorded roundtables for pharma and life sciences executives.

bodyHtml:
With Exeevo’s exclusive 2025 Virtual Thought Leadership Series, stay ahead in the fast-changing life sciences industry. Designed for busy pharma and life sciences executives, these live, interactive one-hour sessions provide a rare opportunity to engage with industry leaders, innovators, and technology experts in real-time.

This year’s series focuses on AI, offering deep dives into the most pressing Life Sciences industry topics.

Unlike pre-recorded webinars, these exclusive sessions foster peer-to-peer discussions on practical challenges, emerging trends, and strategic solutions shaping the future of life sciences. Join a dynamic forum of like-minded professionals and gain actionable insights to confidently navigate the evolving landscape.

Session 1 – April 24, 2025 @ 11 AM PST

How Commercial can sell faster and smarter with AI

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming sales, but its real impact goes beyond the initial buzz. For many sales professionals, AI feels more like science fiction than a practical tool for enhancing sales processes and performance.

  • Understand the current AI landscape in sales and its impact on you and your team.
  • Explore practical AI tools and how they integrate in different solutions
  • Gain actionable insights to enhance sales efficiency and effectiveness with AI.
Register now >

Session 2 – May 15, 2025 @ 3 PM CET

Learn how to operationalize AI to drive business impact and ROI

Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to revolutionize business operations, but unlocking its true impact requires more than just adoption—it demands effective implementation and integration. This webinar explores how organizations can operationalize AI to maximize business impact, improve efficiency, and drive measurable ROI. Experts will share strategies for embedding AI into core workflows, overcoming implementation challenges, and leveraging data-driven insights to optimize decision-making.

  • Integrating AI into Business Operations – Learn how to seamlessly embed AI into existing workflows to enhance efficiency and productivity.
  • Maximizing ROI with AI – Discover actionable strategies to measure and improve the return on AI investments across various business functions.
  • Overcoming AI Implementation Challenges – Gain insights into common roadblocks and best practices for successful AI deployment at scale.
Register now >

Session 3 – May 29, 2025 @ 3 PM CET

How to unlock omnichannel with accelerated AI insights

In today’s evolving pharmaceutical landscape, delivering personalized and effective omnichannel experiences is critical for success. This webinar explores how life sciences companies can leverage AI and cloud technology to enhance marketing and customer engagement strategies. Attendees will gain insights into building the right technology capabilities to empower omnichannel and marketing teams, predict future physician and customer behaviors, and create a future-proof strategy that integrates innovation seamlessly.

  • Enhancing Omnichannel Capabilities – Equip marketing teams with the best tools to select the right channels for each audience.
  • AI-Driven Forecasting – Leverage AI to predict physician and customer needs, driving next best actions.
  • Future-Proofing Strategy – Embed cutting-edge cloud and AI solutions into today’s omnichannel approach to ensure long-term success.
Register now >

Ten reasons to attend Exeevo’s 2025 Thought Leadership Series

  1. Exclusive Access – Engage in live, unrecorded discussions with top industry leaders, innovators, and technology experts.
  2. Real-World Insights – Explore practical challenges and solutions tailored for pharma and life sciences executives.
  3. Interactive & Engaging – Participate in peer-driven conversations, not just passive listening.
  4. Time-Efficient – One-hour sessions designed for busy professionals, delivering maximum value in minimal time.
  5. Stay Ahead of Trends – Gain early insights into emerging technologies, market shifts, and regulatory changes.
  6. Actionable Strategies – Walk away with concrete takeaways to drive innovation and growth in your organization.
  7. Expand Your Network – Connect with like-minded peers and industry influencers in a collaborative setting.
  8. No Sales Pitches – Pure thought leadership with meaningful discussions, not product promotions.
  9. Shape the Conversation – Engage in live Q&A and discussions focusing on your priorities and challenges.
  10. Future-Focused – Prepare for the evolving life sciences landscape with insights from those shaping the industry.

Don’t miss this opportunity to engage, learn, and lead with confidence!

Frequently asked Exeevo Thought Leadership Session Questions

Accordions Accordion

How many executives participate in a session?

Each Exeevo 2025 Virtual Thought Leadership Series roundtable is limited to just six participants to ensure a high-quality, interactive discussion. This small group format allows for meaningful engagement, deeper conversations, and valuable peer-to-peer insights.


Accordion

Are the sessions recorded?

No, the Exeevo 2025 Virtual Thought Leadership sessions are not recorded. This ensures a confidential, open discussion where participants can freely share insights, challenges, and strategies without concerns about being on the record.

Accordion

Who can register for the roundtables?

The Exeevo 2025 Virtual Thought Leadership Series is exclusively designed for Pharma and Life Sciences executives, including decision-makers, industry leaders, and innovators. Registration is limited to Vice President and Senior Vice President roles such as:

  • Commercial, Medical, and Digital Transformation
  • Marketing, Sales, and Customer Engagement Executives
  • Medical Affairs and Market Access Professionals
  • IT, Innovation, and Data Analytics Experts

These invite-only, live sessions ensure meaningful discussions among like-minded peers shaping the future of life sciences.

Accordion

Can I participate in more than one round table session?

No, participants can only choose one of the three roundtables above.

Accordion

Is there a fee to participate?

Participation in the Exeevo 2025 Virtual Thought Leadership Series is free. These exclusive sessions are designed to foster open discussions and knowledge-sharing among pharma and life sciences executives, with no cost or obligation to attend.

seo.title: Why a CRM Matters for HCP Events
seo.description: Explore how the synergy between CRMs and innovative event engagement can lead to more meaningful HCP interactions.

bodyHtml:
From one to a few video calls to complex medical congresses, significant fragmentation exists in how events are managed and integrated with CRM systems. Different parts of the event lifecycle, from planning and approval to execution and follow-up, are often managed in silos.

This fragmentation extends to the data generated from events, which is not seamlessly integrated into CRM systems. This leads to a disjointed understanding of HCP interactions and preferences. Could it be time to reevaluate traditional CRM and event management practices?

Join us to explore how the synergy between CRMs and innovative event engagement can lead to more meaningful interactions, deeper insights, and significantly improved engagement quality with HCPs.

What You Will Learn

  • Discover a holistic approach to event management that leads to omnichannel engagement
  • Learn how to overcome the challenges of integrating event data
  • Understand the role of AI in identifying engagement patterns

Who Should Attend

  • Heads of Omnichannel Platforms/Engagement
  • Digital Leads, Digital Marketing Managers
  • Congress & Event Enablement Directors/Managers
  • Heads of Commercial Excellence; Customer Engagement Excellence Managers

bodyHtml:
The pharmaceutical industry is currently being disrupted by artificial intelligence (AI), as technology and healthcare become increasingly intertwined. At the upcoming Reuters Events Pharma 2024, Aaron Bjork, a prominent thought leader with a 21-year tenure at Microsoft, will deliver the opening keynote titled ‘The AI Prescription for Pharma’. The keynote promises to shed light on Generative AI’s transformative impact on Life Sciences and chart a course for innovation and unprecedented human-AI collaboration in the pharmaceutical landscape.

During the keynote, Bjork will discuss how Generative AI is disrupting Life Sciences and how it differs from previous technology movements. He will explore the potential of Generative AI in fostering collaboration between humans and machines and whether humans will be replaced by AI or work alongside it. Attendees will learn how to prepare their team or organization for the AI wave.

Mark your calendars for April 16 and take your seat by 9 a.m. Get ready to ride the wave of AI with one of the most influential thought leaders in technology and productivity.

The visionary behind the keynote: Aaron Bjork

Aaron Bjork, is a Partner Director of Product Management at Microsoft, where he leads Dynamics 365 Sales and Copilot for Sales. His journey from a software engineer to a recognized Agile thought leader is marked by significant Microsoft contributions to Azure IoT, Azure DevOps, and Visual Studio. His deep understanding of how teams can thrive in a tech-driven environment, combined with his forward-leaning leadership style and vision, makes him an expert in the evolving landscape of AI and pharma.

bodyHtml:
As pharma companies grapple with the complexities of an evolving healthcare environment, rapidly emerging technologies such as generative AI are unlocking new ways to streamline operations, optimize customer relationships, and unlock new avenues of value for users and customers alike. In this 90-minute virtual roundtable, Commercial IT decision-makers will gain vital insights into leveraging the power of Generative AI across their customer infrastructure, ultimately leading to more efficient business processes, improved customer relationships, and a significant competitive edge in the pharma industry.

The discussion will commence with a brief introduction to generative AI, providing a broad overview of its principles, functioning, and potential. This segment will help attendees build a solid understanding of generative AI, its divergence from traditional AI approaches, and its potential in the pharmaceutical industry.

Diving deeper, we focus on the potential use cases for Generative AI in enhancing CRM. Through discussion, we will uncover a range of opportunities and challenges, including predictive modeling, automating customer interactions, enhancing the usability of CRM tools, and facilitating personalized marketing.

By the end of the session, participants will be equipped with knowledge about generative AI’s role in transforming CRM in pharma, empowering them to make informed decisions for their organizations about how best to bring its capabilities into their business and inspire new ways of working.

Seats are limited to 8 participants so register now to reserve your spot. This virtual roundtable is not broadcast or recorded, so attendees can ask questions and share their own perspectives without concern.

Register for USA September 28, 2023 – 11 AM PST | 2 PM ET

Register for EU October 26, 2023 – 11 AM CET

About George Corugedo

Mr. Corugedo embarked on his illustrious career as a Researcher pioneering the art of modeling planetary shapes and their peculiarities with intricate geometric techniques at the University of Arizona’s Lunar and Planetary Labs. Collaborating closely with NASA and using data from Voyager I’s observations of Saturn’s largest moon, Titan, he crafted sophisticated methods for capturing planetary profiles, from bulges to atmospheric intricacies. Though seemingly specialized, this deep dive into the scientific method would set the tone for his foray into the realms of data, technology, and analytics in the corporate sphere.


Subsequently, at the globally renowned management consulting behemoth, Accenture, Mr. Corugedo’s journey took another significant turn. Here, he founded the groundbreaking Data Mining Lab and the Customer Insights Group and infused his scientific rigor into predictive analytics, predominantly in the realm of customer behaviors. Mr. Corugedo’s innovative stance birthed a streamlined data monetization cycle, hinged on the Data, Insights, and Action triad.


Drawing from his foundation in scientific precision and firsthand experience with Global 500 entities, Mr. Corugedo ventured into entrepreneurship, spearheading startups like Riskuity, ClarityBlue, and Redpoint Global. While the former two witnessed successful exits, Redpoint Global flourished, boasting over $100 Million in ARR and securing a notable position in Gartner’s Leadership Quadrants.


At Redpoint, in his role as the founder and CTO, Mr. Corugedo shaped the company’s strategic trajectory. Within a mere 18 months, Redpoint functionality stood toe-to-toe with industry giants like Unica and Adobe, in the campaign management sector. Under his leadership, the company not only set the gold standard in data quality, curation and lineage but also propelled the wave of data-centric culture that is prevalent today. Moreover, Redpoint was among the pioneers to introduce a fully automated AI/ML suite for business users, which was received with resounding acclaim.


Currently, as a strategist in Microsoft’s Americas GPS, Mr. Corugedo’s vast and diverse experience forms the bedrock of his consultancy endeavors with a select number Microsoft’s premier partners. Collaborating intimately with their product leadership teams, he seamlessly fuses strategy, market dynamics, and technical ability to deliver unmatched successes consistently.

Life sciences organizations need data-driven insights and solutions that provide a complete 360-degree view of their customers and inform how best to act or respond. To stay ahead of the competition, companies must now be open to engaging with their customers anytime, anywhere, and ensure that every conversation, visit or view is relevant and meaningful.  

Join this panel discussion to hear from industry experts on where pharma stands on CX and how to get ahead of emerging trends in customer engagement that will impact how you deliver the omnichannel, personalized approach you need for you business. The panel will share what they’re doing to make CX a central theme in their customer operations, the challenges they’re working to overcome and the impact these efforts are having.
